01

“the Day they will be tormented over the Fire”

An explanation transmitted from ʿIkrima (Q 51:13).

905
Explanation from ʿIkrima No. 905: 1: 4

ʿIkrima

English
Transmission wording
905: 1:4. Sufyan, from Husayn, from Ikrima, on His words
"the Day they will be tormented over the Fire": He said, burned (verse 13).
العربية
905: 1: 4 سفيان عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ فِي قَوْلِهِ يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يفتنون قال يحرقون (الآية 13) .

02

“they used to sleep but little of the night”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibrāhīm and al-Ḍaḥḥāk (Q 51:17).

906
Explanation from Ibrāhīm No. 906: 2: 1

Ibrāhīm

English
Transmission wording
906: 2:1. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, on His words
"they used to sleep but little of the night": He said, they used to sleep little (verse 17).
العربية
906: 2: 1 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي قَوْلِهِ كَانُوا قَلِيلا مِنَ الليل ما يهجعون قَالَ كَانُوا قَلِيلًا مَا يَنَامُونَ (الآية 17) .

al-Ḍaḥḥāk

English
Transmission wording

04

“I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me”

An explanation transmitted from Zayd ibn Aslam (Q 51:56).

909
Explanation from Zayd ibn Aslam No. 909: 5: 3

Zayd ibn Aslam

English
Transmission wording
909: 5:3. Sufyan, from Ibn Jurayj, from Zayd ibn Aslam, on His words
"I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me": He said, what they were molded upon of wretchedness and happiness (verse 56).
العربية
909: 5: 3 سفيان عن بن جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ فِي قَوْلِهِ وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ والإنس إلا ليعبدون قَالَ مَا جُبِلُوا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الشقاء والسعادة. (الآية 56) .
